# Daniel Short

> Supplemental, AI-readable summaries of Daniel Short's projects, tools, experiments, and contact information.

Canonical site: https://www.danielshort.me/
Each main link opens the authoritative public page. Its adjacent AI summary link opens a shorter, optional /ai/ page that canonicalizes back to that public page. AI platforms may use either version; this file does not change what the main URL serves.

## Start Here

- [Daniel Short | Data Analytics, ML Projects & Web Tools](https://www.danielshort.me/): Solving everyday problems with data and thoughtful tools. Explore Daniel Short’s analytics, machine learning projects, and browser games. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/index))
- [Portfolio](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio): Project library of data projects, software experiments, tools, and demos by Daniel Short. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio))
- [Browser Tools for Writing, Images & Campaigns](https://www.danielshort.me/tools): Use free, privacy-conscious browser tools for text comparison, writing cleanup, UTM links, QR codes, image optimization, and screen recording. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools))
- [Browser Games & Interactive Simulations](https://www.danielshort.me/games): Six playable experiments in probability, progression, and interactive systems. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/games))
- [Contact](https://www.danielshort.me/contact): Send Daniel Short a note about projects, tools, ideas, or questions. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/contact))

## Projects

- [Baby Name Predictor](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/babynames): Explore a baby-name recommendation model built from family preferences and historical naming trends, with an interactive demo and project notes. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/babynames))
- [Chatbot (LoRA + RAG)](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/chatbotLora): Explore a Grand Junction chatbot combining retrieval and LoRA tuning, with source-linked answers, an interactive demo, and evaluation limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/chatbotLora))
- [COVID-19 Outbreak Drivers](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/covidAnalysis): Explore historical ICU strain signals in HHS data with an interactive state-level risk demo, XGBoost methods, and documented evaluation limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/covidAnalysis))
- [Delivery Tip](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/deliveryTip): Explore an Excel analysis of delivery shifts and neighborhoods built from personal delivery records to inform where and when to work. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/deliveryTip))
- [Synthetic Digit Generator](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/digitGenerator): Generate MNIST-style handwritten digits with a variational autoencoder. Explore the live demo, training approach, and model limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/digitGenerator))
- [Handwriting Legibility Scoring](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/handwritingRating): Try a handwritten-digit recognition demo and compare MNIST results with a small personal handwriting sample. Review the methods and limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/handwritingRating))
- [Nonogram Solver](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/nonogram): Watch a trained agent solve five-by-five Nonogram puzzles and explore the reinforcement-learning approach, demo, and evaluation limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/nonogram))
- [Pizza Tips Regression Modeling](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/pizza): Explore regression models of delivery tips using delivery records and weather data, with methods, findings, and limits on interpretation. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/pizza))
- [Pizza Delivery Dashboard](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/pizzaDashboard): Explore 1,251 historical pizza delivery records in Tableau, with tip summaries, city comparisons, a tip distribution, and monthly delivery counts. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/pizzaDashboard))
- [Store-Level Loss & Sales ETL](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/retailStore): Explore a retail loss and sales data pipeline with an interactive dashboard for comparing stores, spotting unusual patterns, and planning investigations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/retailStore))
- [Shape Classifier Demo](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/shapeClassifier): Draw one of five shapes and try a serverless classifier trained on Quick, Draw! sketches. Explore the model, deployment, and limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/shapeClassifier))
- [Sheet Music Watermark Removal & Upscale](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/sheetMusicUpscale): Compare original, restored, and upscaled sheet-music scans. Explore the U-Net and VDSR workflow, project code, and evaluation limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/sheetMusicUpscale))
- [Smart Sentence Retriever](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/smartSentence): Find relevant sentences by meaning in an interactive semantic-search demo. Explore the NLP workflow, deployment, and evaluation limitations. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/smartSentence))
- [Empty-Package Shrink Dashboard](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/targetEmptyPackage): Explore an anonymized retail shrink dashboard that compares empty-package incident counts, retail value, locations, and trends over time. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/targetEmptyPackage))
- [UFO Sightings Dashboard](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/ufoDashboard): Explore historical UFO report records in Tableau, with geographic, seasonal, time-of-day, and reported-shape comparisons for the contiguous U.S. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/ufoDashboard))
- [danielshort.me](https://www.danielshort.me/portfolio/website): Explore how Daniel Short built this portfolio with practical browser tools, a searchable project library, shared navigation, and generated pages. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/portfolio/website))

## Tools

- [Background Remover](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/background-remover): Remove backgrounds from your photos. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/background-remover))
- [Image Optimizer](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/image-optimizer): Resize, compress, and convert images on your device. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/image-optimizer))
- [Non-breaking Space Cleaner](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/nbsp-cleaner): Find hard spaces and copy clean text. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/nbsp-cleaner))
- [Oxford Comma Checker](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/oxford-comma-checker): Find candidate lists and review comma usage in context. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/oxford-comma-checker))
- [Point of View Checker](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/point-of-view-checker): Find mixed point of view and review it in context. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/point-of-view-checker))
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/qr-code-generator): Create QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, and contacts. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/qr-code-generator))
- [Screen Recorder](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/screen-recorder): Record your screen and download the clip in browser-supported formats with optional system audio. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/screen-recorder))
- [Text Compare](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/text-compare): Compare two drafts and review the changes. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/text-compare))
- [UTM Batch Builder](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/utm-batch-builder): Build campaign links in batches and export a clean CSV. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/utm-batch-builder))
- [Word Frequency Analyzer](https://www.danielshort.me/tools/word-frequency): Find frequent words and phrases, then review them in context. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/tools/word-frequency))

## Games

- [Ocean Wave Simulator](https://www.danielshort.me/games/ocean-wave-simulation): Explore a free ocean wave simulator in your browser. Adjust wind, swell, daylight, and camera, or relax with ambient wave sound. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/games/ocean-wave-simulation))
- [Probability Engine](https://www.danielshort.me/games/probability-engine): Construct slot reels, chain synergies, automate a casino floor, and test long-run probability systems. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/games/probability-engine))
- [Double-Zero Roulette](https://www.danielshort.me/games/roulette): Run a double-zero table, inspect bet layouts, and track recent-spin distributions over time. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/games/roulette))
- [Stellar Dogfight](https://www.danielshort.me/games/stellar-dogfight): Pilot a nimble fighter, duel adaptive AI opponents, and tune upgrades across repeated combat loops. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/games/stellar-dogfight))
- [Stormbreak: Idle Olympus](https://www.danielshort.me/games/stormbreak): Command Zeus, farm mythic hordes, and turn lightning, loot, and offline gains into a compounding idle-action loop. ([AI summary](https://www.danielshort.me/ai/games/stormbreak))
